topic: Dependabot: group updates and use cooldown so dependency PRs stay reviewable
text:
One pull request per outdated dependency is Dependabot's default. Leave it on and the PR list becomes noise nobody reads.

Two options in dependabot.yml fix most of that:

- groups: combine updates into one PR, matched by patterns, dependency-type or update-types (e.g. minor and patch only)
- cooldown: delay version updates after a release. GitHub's docs say a 3-day default applies even if you configure nothing, and security updates skip it

Unmatched dependencies still get their own PRs, so major bumps stay separate.

My rule of thumb: group minor and patch updates weekly, keep majors individual, and never delay security updates. Waiting a few days after a release costs little.

How do you keep dependency PRs from piling up in your repos?
